0022600091.text: The Houston Rockets host the Dallas Mavericks in both teams' 2026-27 openers, and Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions for the Rockets. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel), all listed as out. The teams split their four meetings in 2025-26, and Houston won the most recent one 111-107 in Houston on January 31, 2026.
